screen.minecraftty.security.title: Host terminal access
screen.minecraftty.security.body: minecraftty starts a real shell on this Linux host. Commands run as the same user as Minecraft and can read, change, or delete your files. Continue?
screen.minecraftty.unsupported.title: Unsupported platform
screen.minecraftty.unsupported.body: minecraftty is Linux-only for this MVP.

screen.minecraftty.terminal.status: F12: return | F10: settings | Esc: terminal | exit/Ctrl+D: close shell
screen.minecraftty.config.title: Terminal Settings
screen.minecraftty.config.shell_restart: Shell changes apply when a new terminal session starts.
